input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，有一个人叫神农。一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了，神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 一看很多人正在吃一些植物：看到，一……就
- 神农想帮别人：帮他们，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，Both parts mean “in ancient times,” so using them together is redundant. [vocab list]
2. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 一天，神农：一天，他，Use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence when the named character has just been introduced and no other male character competes as the referent. [rule: none]
3. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了：一看到很多人正在吃一些植物，就发现一些人一吃植物就生病了，The sequence pattern needs “一……就……”; use “看到” because the intended meaning is that he successfully sees the scene. [teacher rule: yi_jiu]
4. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃：因为神农想帮别人，所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃，Use “因为……所以……” to make the cause-and-effect relationship explicit: his wish to help others causes his desire to learn about the plants. [rule: none]

items.reason: 古代 already denotes a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundantly structured; 在古代 is correct.
神农 was just introduced and no competing male referent intervenes, so 她/他 should be used, but 一天，他 is still an unfinished clause.
一看 should be 一看到 here, and the linked events require the 一……就…… pattern.
Adding 因为……所以 correctly makes the causal link explicit, but 帮别人 remains wrong here and should be 帮他们 (and the repeated 神农 is also unnecessarily close reference).
